_hinweis: Content for /syllabus (src/pages/kursinhalte.astro, src/pages/kursinhalte/[level].astro, src/components/KursProgression.astro) and the lesson-plan generator (src/lib/stundenplan.js, which links each grammar line to a topic page by the patterns in GRAMMAR_RULES, so keep the wording of a grammar line close to the topic's name). Everything here is our own, written from the CEFR can-do descriptors. Never copy from coursebooks or from official programmes: no unit titles, no tables of contents, no texts. `lehrwerke` would name coursebook series only ("goes with"), without a level after the name; the lists are empty until Edgar decides whether to name any (scripts/check-lehrwerk-leak.mjs fails the build on series + level). To add a level: insert an object in `niveaus` (order = order on the page and in the timeline); the id becomes the URL (/syllabus/<id>). `pruefung` from A2.2 (DELF / DALF, TCF; see docs/content-plan.md §2): name the exam and the skill, never a task number, a timing or a word count, because those facts are unverified until the exam items check them. `selbstcheck`: exactly 5 sentences describing what a learner can do BEFORE this level. French course plan written by grammar-structure (2026-11-08).

probestunde._hinweis: Empty = no trial-lesson button (there is no booking page yet). Once there is one, put its path here, e.g. "/probestunde". {niveau} is replaced by the level.

niveaus.label: A1.1
niveaus.ziel: You talk about yourself, your family and your day, in simple sentences.

kannZiele: You can introduce yourself: name, country, languages.
You can ask other people their name and where they are from.
You can spell your name.
grammatik: Subject pronouns: je, tu, il, elle, on, nous, vous; tu or vous
être and avoir: je suis, tu es; j'ai, tu as
Question words: comment, où, d'où, qui

kannZiele: You can say your phone number, address and age.
You can fill in a simple form.
grammatik: Numbers up to 1,000: soixante-dix, quatre-vingts
Yes/no questions: Tu as… ? Est-ce que vous êtes… ?
être and avoir: J'ai 30 ans.

kannZiele: You can introduce your family.
You can say who belongs to you and how old they are.
grammatik: Possessives: mon, ma, mes; son, sa, ses
Nouns and gender: le frère, la sœur
Plurals: les enfants, les parents

kannZiele: You can describe your flat and your furniture.
You can say what is in your home and where it is.
grammatik: Articles: le, la, l', les; un, une, des
il y a or c'est: Il y a un canapé. C'est grand.
Adjectives: agreement (la petite cuisine)

kannZiele: You can ask for products and prices in a shop.
You can order in a café.
You can write a shopping list.
grammatik: Articles: un, une, des (des tomates)
Polite requests: je voudrais…
Demonstratives: ce, cet, cette, ces
Question words: combien ça coûte ?
wortschatz: Containers (une bouteille de, un paquet de)

kannZiele: You can describe your daily routine with times.
You can say how often you do something.
grammatik: Present of -er verbs: je parle, tu parles, il parle
Telling the time: à huit heures, le matin
Reflexive verbs: je me lève, je me douche (first look)
Frequency: toujours, parfois, jamais (first look)

kannZiele: You can talk about your hobbies.
You can say what you like and what you don't like.
You can ask others what they do in their free time.
grammatik: aimer + noun or infinitive: j'aime le foot, j'aime nager
Present of -ir and -re verbs: je finis, j'attends
Negation: ne … pas: Je ne travaille pas aujourd'hui.
Linking words: et, ou, mais, parce que

selbstcheck: I can read and write the letters of the Latin alphabet.
I know a few words in French (bonjour, merci, oui, non).
I can say my name in French.
I know the numbers from 1 to 10 in French.
I have some time each week to practise at home.
niveaus.selbstcheckNiedrig: No problem: A1.1 is the beginning, you don't need to know anything yet. In the trial lesson we look together at the best way for you to start.

niveaus.label: A1.2
niveaus.ziel: You get by in everyday life: in town, at the doctor's, in shops and at the mairie.

kannZiele: You can ask the way and understand simple directions.
You can buy a ticket for the bus, the métro or the train.
grammatik: Key irregular verbs: aller, venir, prendre
Towns and countries: à Lyon, en France, au Maroc
Saying where: à côté de, en face de, entre
Question words: Comment je vais à… ? Où est… ?

kannZiele: You can say what hurts at the doctor's.
You can understand simple advice and instructions.
grammatik: avoir mal à: j'ai mal à la tête, au dos
pouvoir, devoir and il faut: Il faut prendre rendez-vous.
être and avoir: J'ai de la fièvre. Je suis fatigué.

bloecke.thema: What are you doing? What will you do?
kannZiele: You can say what you are doing right now.
You can talk about your plans.
You can say what you have done today.
grammatik: être en train de: je suis en train de travailler
Futur proche: je vais appeler
Passé composé: first steps (j'ai mangé)

kannZiele: You can say what you do and where you work.
You can describe your working day.
grammatik: c'est or il est: Il est infirmier. C'est un bon infirmier.
Article or no article: Je suis infirmière.
Key irregular verbs: faire, savoir, connaître

kannZiele: You can ask for clothes in a shop and try them on.
You can compare two things.
grammatik: Comparatives: plus … que, moins … que
Direct object pronouns: le, la (Vous l'avez en bleu ?)
Demonstratives: ce, cette, ces
Adjectives: colours and agreement

kannZiele: You can say the date and when something happens.
You can invite someone and accept or say no.
grammatik: Ordinal numbers and dates: le premier mai, le 3 juin
Telling the time and days: lundi, le lundi
Futur proche for plans

kannZiele: You can make an appointment and ask for a form.
You can give your details at a counter (mairie, bank, doctor's surgery).
grammatik: Polite requests: je voudrais…, est-ce que je peux… ?
Yes/no questions and short answers: Oui, bien sûr. Non, pas encore.
Numbers: dates of birth, phone numbers, postcodes
wortschatz: Proof of address (justificatif de domicile): the words

selbstcheck: I can introduce myself and ask others their name and where they are from.
I can understand numbers, prices and the time.
I can talk about my family.
I can ask for things in a shop.
I can describe my day with times.

niveaus.label: A2.1
niveaus.ziel: You talk about the past, give reasons for your opinion and get by well when you travel.

kannZiele: You can say what your life was like before.
You can talk about what you used to do.
grammatik: Imparfait: avant j'habitais, j'étais, j'allais
Frequency: souvent, d'habitude, tous les jours
Comparatives: plus qu'avant

kannZiele: You can say what you did yesterday or last year.
You can tell a short story from your life.
grammatik: Passé composé with avoir: j'ai parlé, j'ai fini, j'ai pris
Passé composé with être: je suis allé(e), je suis né(e)
depuis, il y a: il y a deux ans, depuis 2022

kannZiele: You can describe a flat and say where things are.
You can talk to a neighbour or a landlord about a small problem.
grammatik: Saying where: sous, derrière, au-dessus de
Indefinites: quelque chose, quelqu'un, tout, chaque
Partitive articles: du, de la, des; pas de

kannZiele: You can explain why you do something.
You can say what you have to do at work.
grammatik: parce que, comme, donc; je pense que
pouvoir, vouloir, devoir and il faut
Indirect object pronouns: je lui donne, on me paie

kannZiele: You can say how much you like something.
You can describe how you do things.
grammatik: Adverbs: -ment; bon or bien
Negation: ne … plus, ne … jamais, ne … rien
Partitive articles: faire du sport, de la musique

kannZiele: You can compare habits and say what is better.
You can talk about your routine and your health.
grammatik: Comparatives and superlatives: aussi … que, le meilleur
Reflexive verbs: je me repose, je me couche tard
Imperative: mange, ne fume pas, reposez-vous

kannZiele: You can plan a trip and book a room.
You can say what you take and who gets what.
grammatik: Futur proche for trips
Towns and countries: à Nice, en Espagne, au Portugal
Direct object pronouns: le, la, les (je le prends)

selbstcheck: I can say what I have done today (j'ai…).
I can ask the way and understand the answer.
I can tell a doctor what hurts.
I can make or cancel an appointment.
I can say in a shop what I like and what fits me.

niveaus.label: A2.2
niveaus.ziel: You describe people and things in more detail, give advice and deal with offices and work. A2 is also the level France currently asks for a first multi-year residence card; check the official rules for your case.

kannZiele: You can tell someone about a festival or a party.
You can say when things happened.
grammatik: Passé composé with être and avoir: review
Ordinal numbers and dates
Key irregular verbs: review

kannZiele: You can describe what someone is like.
You can say what you have in common.
grammatik: Article or no article: J'aime le café. Je n'ai pas de voiture.
Adjectives: agreement and position (un bel appartement)
Comparatives: aussi … que, autant que

kannZiele: You can ask for help and offer it.
You can give simple advice.
grammatik: devoir and il faut for advice
Polite requests: j'aimerais, ça vous dérange de… ?
Imperative with pronouns: aide-moi, appelle-le

kannZiele: You can pay, return a product and complain politely.
You can read a bill and understand the main charges.
grammatik: Direct object pronouns: je le renvoie, je la paie
Indefinites: chaque, tout, autre
Indirect object pronouns: je lui écris

kannZiele: You can talk about the weather and the seasons in France.
You can say what you do for the environment.
grammatik: Negation: ne … plus, ne … jamais: review
Imparfait: describing the weather and the place
Partitive articles: de l'eau, moins de plastique

kannZiele: You can talk about your work experience.
You can answer simple questions in an interview.
grammatik: Passé composé with avoir in your CV: j'ai travaillé, j'ai appris
parce que, comme, donc
Saying how often: souvent, d'habitude

kannZiele: You can explain what you need at an office (mairie, préfecture, CAF) and understand what to bring.
You can ask someone to repeat or to write something down.
grammatik: Polite requests: Pourriez-vous… ? Je voudrais…
Direct object pronouns: Je le signe ? Je l'apporte ?
Ordinal numbers: au premier étage, au deuxième étage

selbstcheck: I can talk about my childhood.
I can give reasons with parce que and comme.
I can ask politely: Pourriez-vous… ? Je voudrais…
I can compare things: plus grand que, le meilleur.
I can talk about my hobbies (j'aime, ça m'intéresse).

niveaus.label: B1.1
niveaus.ziel: You talk about experiences, plans and opinions, also on topics that are less familiar.

kannZiele: You can tell the story of your life or of a journey in the right order.
You can describe the background of an event.
grammatik: Passé composé or imparfait: telling a story
Plus-que-parfait: j'avais mangé (first look)
depuis, il y a, pendant, en, dans

kannZiele: You can talk about your experience and your plans at work.
You can write a short email to a company.
grammatik: Relative pronouns: qui, que, où, dont
venir de, être en train de: review
ce qui, ce que: ce qui compte, c'est…

kannZiele: You can say what you think about the news and social media.
You can give arguments for and against.
grammatik: Linkers: pourtant, cependant, en revanche
Verbs + à and de: penser à, parler de

kannZiele: You can follow a doctor's instructions and ask for details.
You can tell someone what to do and what not to do.
grammatik: Imperative: prends, ne prends pas, prends-le
Verbs like plaire: manquer à, plaire à, falloir
y and en: j'y vais, j'en prends
wortschatz: The health system (carte Vitale, médecin traitant)

kannZiele: You can sort out a problem with a landlord or flatmates.
You can say what would be better.
grammatik: Real conditions: si + présent
Conditionnel: j'aimerais, à ta place, je…
Double object pronouns: je le lui dis

kannZiele: You can talk about plans and predictions.
You can solve a problem while travelling.
grammatik: Futur simple: je parlerai, j'aurai
Time clauses: quand + futur, dès que

kannZiele: You can talk about relationships and what people are like.
You can say whose something is.
grammatik: savoir or connaître, and other confusable verbs
Possessive pronouns: le mien, la tienne

selbstcheck: I can talk about past events with the passé composé and the imparfait.
I can give advice: Tu dois… Il faut…
I can describe people and things with être and adjectives.
I can write a simple email to a company.
I can say when something happened with quand and après.

niveaus.label: B1.2
niveaus.ziel: You discuss, describe processes and write clear texts, and you are ready for a B1 exam.

kannZiele: You can say what you hope and what you want others to do.
You can discuss what should change.
grammatik: Subjonctif présent: the forms (que je parle, que je finisse, que j'aille)
Subjunctive after wishes and feelings: je veux que, j'aimerais que

kannZiele: You can talk about courses and qualifications.
You can say what something is for.
grammatik: Infinitive or subjunctive: je veux partir, je veux que tu partes
Purpose: pour + infinitive, pour que + subjunctive

kannZiele: You can report what other people ask.
You can ask for information politely.
grammatik: Indirect questions: il demande si, je ne sais pas où
Demonstrative pronouns: celui, celle, celui-ci

kannZiele: You can compare offers and make a complaint.
You can talk about having things done for you.
grammatik: faire + infinitive: je fais réparer mon vélo
Adjective position: un grand homme, ma propre voiture
Word formation: -tion, -age, -eur, re-

kannZiele: You can talk about what will happen when things change.
You can write a formal email or a complaint.
grammatik: Time clauses: quand, dès que, pendant que, avant de
quand or si
ce qui, ce que, ce dont

kannZiele: You can talk about films, books and events.
You can recommend something and say why.
grammatik: Verbs + à and de: s'intéresser à, se souvenir de
Verbs like plaire: ce film m'a plu

kannZiele: You know the format of the exam you want to take and can manage your time.
You can do a full practice test.
grammatik: Review: past tenses and time clauses
Review: subjunctive and conditions
wortschatz: Useful phrases for writing and speaking

selbstcheck: I can tell a story in the right order (d'abord, ensuite, pendant que).
I can give my opinion and support it with pourtant and cependant.
I can say what I would like to do (j'aimerais…).
I can write a complaint or a formal email.
I can plan a meeting or a trip with other people.

niveaus.label: B2.1
niveaus.ziel: You understand longer texts, argue convincingly and write in a formal style, at work and in study.

kannZiele: You can discuss working conditions and give reasons for your view.
You can write a formal letter of application.
grammatik: Subjunctive after opinion and doubt: je ne pense pas que, il est possible que
Collocations: prendre une décision, faire attention

kannZiele: You can follow a news report and say what it means.
You can report what was said.
grammatik: Passive: la loi a été adoptée, on dit que, ça se vend bien
Reported speech with tense concordance: il a dit qu'il viendrait

kannZiele: You can describe the housing market where you live.
You can say exactly what you are looking for.
grammatik: lequel and the subjunctive in relative clauses: je cherche un appartement qui soit calme
Concession: bien que + subjunctive, même si

kannZiele: You can talk about stress, moods and how you deal with them.
You can tell someone about a small accident or a mistake.
grammatik: Gérondif: en marchant, en travaillant
Participle agreement: elle s'est blessée, les clés que j'ai perdues

kannZiele: You can talk about what would be different under other conditions.
You can say what had happened before.
grammatik: Plus-que-parfait: j'avais déjà fini
Si clauses: si j'avais le temps, je… / si j'avais su…

kannZiele: You can read a contract or terms and ask about the details.
You can explain results and effects.
grammatik: Adjectives + prepositions: prêt à, capable de, responsable de
Concession and consequence: si bien que, de sorte que, tellement … que

kannZiele: You can keep a conversation going and interrupt politely.
You can say that something doesn't matter to you, or that anyone could do it.
grammatik: Discourse markers in speech: bon, ben, enfin, du coup
n'importe qui, n'importe quoi, n'importe où

selbstcheck: I have finished B1 or feel confident at B1.
I can use the present subjunctive for wishes and feelings.
I can link ideas with aunque, sin embargo and por lo tanto.
I can give a talk on a topic for 3–4 minutes.
I understand the main points of the news on the radio.

niveaus.label: B2.2
niveaus.ziel: You write and speak precisely, also about abstract topics, and you are ready for a B2 exam.

kannZiele: You can discuss scenarios and what could have happened.
You can weigh up possible solutions.
grammatik: Si clauses: si + plus-que-parfait, conditionnel passé
Futur antérieur: quand nous aurons fini (introduction)

kannZiele: You can summarise a report in your own words.
You can describe processes in a formal style.
grammatik: Passive: il a été démontré que, on a découvert
Nominalisation in formal writing (introduction)

kannZiele: You can explain how decisions are made in France.
You can report requests and demands.
grammatik: Reported speech: il m'a demandé de venir, elle a dit que…
Subjunctive after opinion and doubt: je doute que, il n'est pas sûr que

kannZiele: You can talk about belonging, languages and customs.
You can describe how a person or a place has changed.
grammatik: lequel: la ville dans laquelle je vis, auquel, duquel
Gérondif and participe présent

kannZiele: You can write a report or a review.
You can say what has been done and decided.
grammatik: Participle agreement in writing: les documents que nous avons envoyés
Collocations: porter plainte, prendre contact, mettre en place

kannZiele: You can discuss a rule or a law and say what you think of it.
You can make a formal complaint.
grammatik: Concession: quoique, si … que, sans que
Adjectives + prepositions: content de, fier de, responsable de

kannZiele: You know the format of the exam you want to take and can manage your time.
You can do a full practice test.
grammatik: Review: subjunctive and si clauses
Review: reported speech and linkers
wortschatz: Useful phrases for writing and speaking

selbstcheck: I can write formal emails without help.
I understand si clauses with the plus-que-parfait when I read them.
I can report what someone said (il a dit que…).
I can disagree in a discussion and suggest a compromise.
I understand newspaper articles on familiar topics.

niveaus.label: C1
niveaus.ziel: You understand demanding texts, speak spontaneously and fluently, and write well-structured texts.

kannZiele: You can understand long factual texts and summarise them.
You can present results in a formal style.
grammatik: Nominalisation in formal writing
Subjonctif passé: bien qu'il soit parti

kannZiele: You can write a report or a proposal.
You can lead a meeting and sum up.
grammatik: Participle clauses: ayant terminé, la réunion terminée
Formal connectors: en raison de, néanmoins, toutefois

kannZiele: You can argue about abstract topics and answer counter-arguments.
You can set conditions and limits precisely.
grammatik: Conditions without si: à condition que, à moins que, au cas où
Futur antérieur: une fois que nous aurons décidé

kannZiele: You can tell fact from opinion in a long article or a programme.
You can put the focus exactly where you want it.
grammatik: Cleft sentences: c'est Léa qui…, ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est…
Modal nuance: il aurait dû; the news conditional (selon la police, il aurait fui)

kannZiele: You can talk about how French varies in France and the French-speaking world.
You can switch between formal and informal style.
grammatik: Passé simple for reading: il fut, elle vint
Discourse markers and register

kannZiele: You can explain complex causes and effects.
You can turn a spoken explanation into formal writing.
grammatik: Nominalisation and verbal style: décider, la décision
Formal connectors: or, par conséquent, en effet

kannZiele: You can write a review and give a nuanced opinion.
You can follow a discussion about a film or a book.
grammatik: comme si + imparfait; quand bien même
Cohesion: celui-ci, ce dernier, le premier … le second

kannZiele: You know the format of the exam you want to take and can manage your time.
You can do a full practice test.
grammatik: Review: formal style and sentence structure
Review: subjunctive and tense
wortschatz: Useful phrases for writing and speaking

selbstcheck: I have finished B2 or feel confident at B2.
I can report what other people said, with the right tenses.
I can argue about abstract topics and give counter-arguments.
I understand factual texts and talks on most topics.
I can switch between a formal and an informal style.
